capabilities: Remove every image embed from a note via a right-click command
Move image files referenced only by that note to .trash with folder structure preserved
Keep files for images shared by two or more notes and remove only the embed
Detect both wiki and Markdown embed syntax, including network URLs
Show a confirm modal with embed and file counts before deleting
disambiguation: Not an image editor or compressor; it only removes embed syntax and trashes now-unreferenced image files.
extras: Not yet submitted to the community plugin browser; manual installation requires copying main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into the plugins folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bulk-remove image embeds from a note and clean up the image files those embeds referenced.
summary: Right-click command that strips all image embeds from a note and moves image files no other note references to .trash.
